name: Katsura (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Katsura village emblem in red: a six-pointed star of two overlapping triangles, like a stylised letter A.
history: Flag of the former village of Katsura in Ibaraki Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-01.

features.role: Katsura village emblem — a six-pointed star of two overlapping triangles, like a stylised letter A
